author: vicrodh

scope: archive integrity and checksums of the public release assets
no home paths in packaged files
installation of the exact release ZIP in the published Chilpa 0.1.3 package
Firefox Snap sign-in, library and playback
helper handshake before Firefox detection, and its startup log
library synchronization with repeated rows and totals that do not match (fixtures)

not_tested: Library synchronization against a live account whose collections repeat rows; fixtures cover it.
Physical DAC checks were not repeated for 0.1.5.

owner_vm_smoke.system: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS virtual machine, glibc 2.43, PipeWire 1.6.2
owner_vm_smoke.result: Sign-in verified; library and playback worked through the PulseAudio-protocol output.

checks.snap_profile: Firefox Snap started through the helper driver could not open a profile under ~/.local/share and started in 12.6 s with ~/snap/firefox/common/chilpa-qbz-profile; the Firefox deb started with either profile.
checks.helper_handshake: Packaged helper on the VM answered in 0.41 s. With a Firefox Flatpak probe held for 4 s, the handshake took 4.91 s with 0.1.4 code and 0.40 s with 0.1.5.
checks.toolchain_paths: The plugin binary keeps 29 Rust standard library source paths under the build machine's toolchain folder; no home paths.

limitations: QConnect remote queue control and DLNA gapless are not supplied.
